name: openviking-memory
description: OpenViking long-term semantic memory for ZCode: auto-recall relevant memories at session start and on every prompt, capture finished turns, and expose find/search/read/remember MCP tools via a stdio proxy. Connection settings come only from the plugin settings UI or the built-in default (environment variables and ov.conf/ovcli.conf are ignored).

url.title: OpenViking server URL
url.description: Base URL of your OpenViking server, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11933. Leave blank to use the built-in default http://127.0.0.1:1933. Environment variables and ov.conf/ovcli.conf are not consulted.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: API key (or bearer token) if the server requires auth. Leave blank for local dev-mode servers.

account.title: Account
account.description: OpenViking account id. Leave blank for the default identity.

user.title: User
user.description: OpenViking user id. Leave blank for the default identity.
